Online Stock-Trading Platform

在线股票交易平台

Designing an Online Stock-Trading Platform

There are a lot of online platforms available to help you invest money in stocks, such as Robinhood, Zerodha, and Groww. These platforms, called stockbrokers, work as intermediaries between stock exchanges and users. Stock exchanges are marketplaces where stocks are bought and sold. A few examples include the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in the US and the National Stock Exchange (NSE) of India. Figure 21-1 illustrates the interaction between the user, the stockbroker, and the stock exchange.

市面上有很多在线平台可以帮你投资股票，例如 Robinhood、Zerodha 和 Groww。这些平台被称为股票经纪商（stockbroker），充当股票交易所与用户之间的中介。股票交易所是买卖股票的市场。几个例子包括美国的纽约证券交易所（NYSE）和印度的国家证券交易所（NSE）。图 21-1 展示了用户、股票经纪商和股票交易所之间的交互。

Buying or selling a stock is called an order. The order is executed on the customer’s behalf by the stockbroker. In a nutshell, you give money to a stockbroker to buy or sell a particular stock, and the broker talks to the stock exchange to execute the order.

买入或卖出一只股票称为一笔订单（order）。订单由股票经纪商代客户执行。简而言之，你把钱交给股票经纪商去买入或卖出某只股票，经纪商再与股票交易所沟通以执行该订单。

This chapter focuses on the design of a stockbroker application, not a stock exchange application. Trading stocks is a complicated topic, and we don’t suggest referring to this chapter as a guide to stock trading but rather as a technical deep dive into the underlying system architecture.
本章聚焦于股票经纪商应用的设计，而不是股票交易所应用的设计。交易股票是一个复杂的话题，我们不建议把本章当作股票交易指南来参考，而应把它当作对底层系统架构的一次技术深入剖析。
Page 565

We recommend surfing through a stockbroker application if you’ve never had a chance to help understand the application features so that you can determine the system requirements of our stockbroker application. Let’s move to those system requirements next.

如果你从来没有用过股票经纪商应用，我们建议你去浏览一下，以帮助理解应用功能，从而你就能确定我们股票经纪商应用的系统需求。下面我们转向这些系统需求。

System Requirements

A stockbroker application offers a wide range of features, but this chapter focuses on the core functionality of buying and selling stocks. The buying and selling of any stock is generally referred to as order execution in the trading world. Let’s start with the functional and nonfunctional requirements of the system, and then we’ll discuss the expected scale.

股票经纪商应用提供广泛的功能，但本章聚焦于买卖股票的核心功能。买卖任何股票在交易界通常称为订单执行（order execution）。我们从系统的功能性和非功能性需求开始，然后讨论预期规模。

Functional and Nonfunctional Requirements

The core feature of any stockbroker application is buying and selling stocks. There are some additional features we need to offer to customers to help them make decisions regarding trading stocks. The application only allows buying and selling of stocks during the trading hours of the stock exchange, which generally are six to seven hours of the day. For example, the trading hours for the Nasdaq stock exchange are 9:30 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. EST.

任何股票经纪商应用的核心功能都是买卖股票。我们还需要向客户提供一些附加功能，以帮助他们就股票交易做出决策。应用只允许在股票交易所的交易时间内买卖股票，交易时间通常为一天中的六到七个小时。例如，Nasdaq 股票交易所的交易时间是美国东部时间上午 9:30 到下午 4:00。

Here is the list of functional requirements that the system should support:

下面是系统应当支持的功能性需求列表：

  • Users can search by stock name or company name. For example, the stock for Amazon.com, Inc. is listed with the name AMZN on the Nasdaq stock exchange.
    用户可以按股票名称或公司名称搜索。例如，Amazon.com, Inc. 的股票在 Nasdaq 股票交易所以 AMZN 的名称上市。
  • The stock price should be updated in real time with other relevant details, such as average trade price, last opening and closing price, and so on.
    股票价格应实时更新，并附带其他相关细节，例如平均成交价、最近的开盘价和收盘价等。
  • Users can buy new stocks and sell existing stocks.
    用户可以买入新股票、卖出已持有的股票。
  • Users can view candlestick charts of any stock over the requested time period.
    用户可以查看任何股票在指定时间段内的 K 线图。
  • Users can view their portfolios with profit and loss (P&L) overall and for individual stocks.
    用户可以查看自己的投资组合，包括整体以及单只股票的盈亏（P&L）。

The NFRs of the system are also very critical and should be taken into consideration during the system design. Here is the list of NFRs that the system should ensure:

系统的非功能性需求也非常关键，在系统设计过程中应当加以考虑。下面是系统应当确保的 NFR 列表：

  • The system should be highly available and able to withstand hardware failures or data center downtimes.
    系统应当高可用，并能够承受硬件故障或数据中心停机。
  • The system should be highly scalable to cater to increasing traffic.
    系统应当高度可扩展，以应对不断增长的流量。
  • The system should be highly reliable and durable. There should not be any loss of messages, such as order execution and responses from stock exchange systems.
    系统应当高度可靠且持久。不应丢失任何消息，例如订单执行以及来自股票交易所系统的响应。
Page 566
  • The system should operate at submillisecond (< 100 ms) latency for market order executions.
    系统在市价订单执行时应当运行在亚毫秒级（< 100 ms）延迟。
  • Strong consistency support is needed in the overall system operations.
    整体系统操作需要强一致性支持。

System Scale

The system operates and interacts with customers heavily during trading hours. During off-market hours, the system runs other jobs, such as gathering the trades of the day from the exchanges and sending executed trade details to the customers. We’ll take Zerodha’s scale numbers as our base and add to it to take into account future growth:

系统在交易时间内大量运行并与客户交互。在非交易时间，系统运行其他作业，例如从交易所收集当天的交易，并把已执行的交易详情发送给客户。我们以 Zerodha 的规模数字为基础，并在此之上加上对未来增长的考量：

  • Number of active users on platform = 50 million
    平台活跃用户数 = 5000 万
  • Number of users actually executing trades = 10 million
    实际执行交易的用户数 = 1000 万
  • Average number of trades per user = 2
    每用户平均交易笔数 = 2
  • Number of trades per day = 20 million
    每日交易笔数 = 2000 万

The 50 million active users are viewing the live stock prices and checking their portfolios, so at any time the system must serve read queries for this set of users. The number of stock-price updates delivered to users per second on average by the broker system is three (for Level 2 data, discussed more in “Designing a Stock Tick System” on page 546). For 50 million active users, the system delivers 150 million stock updates every second.

这 5000 万活跃用户正在查看实时股价、查看自己的投资组合，因此系统在任何时刻都必须为这组用户服务读查询。经纪商系统平均每秒向用户投递的股价更新数为 3 条（针对 Level 2 数据，详见第 546 页“设计股票行情系统”）。对于 5000 万活跃用户，系统每秒投递 1.5 亿条股票更新。

The number of companies listed on the stock exchange varies based on the country and exchange. Here are a few numbers we can take as reference:

在股票交易所上市的公司数量因国家和交易所而异。下面是几个可以参考的数字：

  • NSE, India ~ 2,300
    印度 NSE ~ 2,300 家
  • Nasdaq, US ~ 3,300
    美国 Nasdaq ~ 3,300 家
  • NYSE, US ~ 2,800
    美国 NYSE ~ 2,800 家

You can assume that the number of public companies doesn’t grow exponentially and that only a very few companies are added from time to time. We’ll move to the design of the system next, keeping these requirements and scale considerations in mind.

你可以假设上市公司数量不会指数级增长，只是偶尔新增极少数公司。下面我们带着这些需求和规模考虑，转向系统设计。

Starting with the Design

Like the web crawler and search engine (Chapter 15) and the hotel reservation system (Chapter 18), the stock-trading platform consists of two systems. One system ingests the data from exchange platforms for live stock pricing, and another system executes

与网页爬虫和搜索引擎（第 15 章）以及酒店预订系统（第 18 章）一样，股票交易平台由两个系统组成。一个系统从交易所平台摄入数据以提供实时股价，另一个系统执行

Page 567

customer orders. We’ll first talk about data ingestion to support delivering live and historical stock prices to end users and then move to our system design for buying and selling stocks.

客户订单。我们先谈谈数据摄入，以支持向终端用户投递实时和历史股价，然后再转向买卖股票的系统设计。

Designing a Stock Tick System

Stock tick means the price change of a stock; the broker system captures price changes from the exchange system and streams them to users watching the stocks. The price change is streamed in near real time without any delays to help customers make decisions regarding whether to buy or sell stocks. The architecture is a mirror image of Figure 21-1, where the exchange system streams the data, and then the brokerage application consumes it and further streams it to the end customers.

股票 tick 指一只股票的价格变动；经纪商系统从交易所系统捕获价格变动，并把它们流式传输给正在关注这些股票的用户。价格变动以近实时方式流式传输，没有任何延迟，以帮助客户就买入还是卖出股票做出决策。该架构是图 21-1 的镜像：交易所系统流式传输数据，经纪应用消费数据，并进一步把它流式传输给终端客户。

In “System Scale” on page 545, we assumed that 20 million trades are executed per day on the broker application. There can be multiple such platforms where users are executing trades, and then there are HFT firms for executing automated trading at a high frequency. The point is that the number of trades executed on a stock exchange platform is really huge (take a look at historical data for NSE India and Nasdaq), and consuming all this data inside a brokerage application requires a lot of resources. Further, broker applications need to pay a specific amount to exchange platforms for market-data consumption.

在第 545 页“系统规模”中，我们假设经纪应用每天执行 2000 万笔交易。用户可能在多个这样的平台上执行交易，此外还有 HFT（高频交易）公司以高频执行自动化交易。关键在于，股票交易所平台上执行的交易数量极其庞大（看看 NSE India 和 Nasdaq 的历史数据就知道），而在经纪应用内部消费所有这些数据需要大量资源。此外，经纪应用还需要为市场数据消费向交易所平台支付一笔特定费用。

Keep in mind that most customers don’t require data for every order executed on the exchange platform if we leave HFTs out of the picture: the primary reason is that the user will not be able to comprehend these vast amounts of live data to make decisions without the help of computer algorithms, and stock exchanges charge fees to deliver this data via a well-designed networking infrastructure. To cater to this, stock exchanges generally offer different types of data streams based on the amount of data needed. Taking an example of NSE India (similar levels are offered by other exchange platforms, such as Nasdaq), the real-time data is offered at four levels: levels 1−3 and tick-by-tick (TBT). Level 1 provides the best bid and ask price; level 2 provides market depth data up to five best bid and ask prices; level 3 provides market depth data up to the 20 best bid and ask prices; and TBT provides a full order book (all the orders executed on the exchange platform).

请记住，如果把 HFT 排除在外，大多数客户并不需要交易所平台上执行的每一笔订单的数据：主要原因是，如果没有计算机算法的帮助，用户无法理解如此海量的实时数据来做决策，而股票交易所通过设计良好的网络基础设施投递这些数据是要收费的。为应对这一点，股票交易所通常根据所需数据量提供不同类型的数据流。以 NSE India 为例（其他交易所平台如 Nasdaq 也提供类似层级），实时数据分为四个层级：level 1−3 和逐笔（TBT）。Level 1 提供最优买价和卖价；level 2 提供最多五档最优买卖价的市场深度数据；level 3 提供最多 20 档最优买卖价的市场深度数据；TBT 提供完整订单簿（交易所平台上执行的所有订单）。

The bid price is the highest price a buyer is willing to pay for a specific number of shares of a stock at a particular time. The ask price refers to the lowest price at which a seller agrees to sell a stock.
买价（bid）是买方在某一特定时刻愿意为一定数量股票支付的最高价格。卖价（ask）指卖方同意出售一只股票的最低价格。

We’ll limit the scope of architecture in this chapter to level 1−3 data consumption, considering the system design requirements of a broker application and not an HFT. SSEs and WebSockets, which we discussed in Chapter 6, are good choices for data

考虑到这是经纪应用而不是 HFT 的系统设计需求，我们将本章架构范围限定在 level 1−3 数据消费。我们在第 6 章讨论过的 SSE 和 WebSocket 是从股票交易所消费数据的好选择。

Page 568

consumption from stock exchanges. There is no standard communication protocol used by all the stock exchanges—it varies from one exchange to another—but one of the popular protocols is the Financial Information eXchange (FIX) protocol. The means used for data delivery can also vary from exchange to exchange. Here are a few of the possible methods for delivering market data:

没有一种所有股票交易所都使用的标准通信协议——它因交易所而异——但流行的协议之一是 Financial Information eXchange（FIX）协议。用于数据投递的方式也因交易所而异。下面是投递市场数据的几种可能方法：

Cloud subscription

The exchange allows clients to subscribe to its endpoints and receive the data. The endpoint could be a persistent or one-way connection (depending on the exchange).

交易所允许客户端订阅其端点并接收数据。端点可以是持久连接或单向连接（取决于交易所）。

Direct connection

The exchange offers server racks in its facility, and clients can place hardware in colocated (referred to as colo) locations with exchange servers. The client hardware at the exchange facility is connected to a client’s on-premises data center to directly receive the data. With NSE India, for example, Zerodha’s broker application delivers level 3 data to customers by consuming the TBT data, converting it to level 3, and then streaming it to the user application.

交易所在其设施内提供服务器机架，客户端可以把硬件放在与交易所服务器同址托管（colo）的位置。位于交易所设施内的客户端硬件连接到客户端的本地数据中心，以直接接收数据。例如在 NSE India，Zerodha 的经纪应用通过消费 TBT 数据、把它转换成 level 3，然后流式传输给用户应用，从而向客户投递 level 3 数据。

Vendor connection

A direct connection might not be cost-effective for all consumers. These consumers can leverage vendor integrations and achieve similar functionality. For example, LSEG Data & Analytics is integrated with more than five hundred global exchanges to deliver TBT data.

直接连接对所有消费者而言可能并不划算。这些消费者可以利用供应商集成来获得类似功能。例如，LSEG Data & Analytics 与全球五百多家交易所集成，以投递 TBT 数据。

The exchanges also offer snapshots of historical data to broker applications, which can be used for use cases like candlestick charts.

交易所还向经纪应用提供历史数据快照，可用于 K 线图等用例。

Now, let’s talk about how the broker application’s backend systems make sense of this data and stream it to the front-facing application for viewing. The flow is similar to the data stream delivery between the stock exchanges and brokers. We can think of this architecture in two parts: live stock tick data and historical stock market data.

现在，我们谈谈经纪应用的后端系统如何理解这些数据，并把它流式传输到前置应用供查看。这个流程类似于股票交易所与经纪商之间的数据流投递。我们可以把这个架构分为两部分来思考：实时股票 tick 数据和历史股票市场数据。

Live stock ticks

Latency is critical when delivering live stock ticks to the end customers: the data should be presented to the viewers as soon as it is available from the stock exchanges. This architecture is similar to the messaging architecture in Chapter 19; the only difference is the broker system is the one that is sending messages to users instead of users exchanging messages with one another. Ordering of messages is also important. The technological solution should ensure that the data is reflected to users in the order in which it arrived.

向终端客户投递实时股票 tick 时，延迟至关重要：数据应在从股票交易所获得后尽快呈现给观众。该架构类似于第 19 章中的消息架构；唯一区别是，向用户发送消息的是经纪商系统，而不是用户之间相互交换消息。消息的顺序也很重要。技术方案应当确保数据按到达顺序反映给用户。

The stock updates are consumed by the stock tick consumer service (STCS), one of the backend services in the broker architecture. The STCS is a very lightweight service responsible for forwarding the updates received from exchange systems to

股票更新由股票 tick 消费者服务（STCS）消费，它是经纪商架构中的后端服务之一。STCS 是一个非常轻量的服务，负责把从交易所系统收到的更新转发给

Page 569

internal backend services. Message forwarding is done asynchronously by publishing the updates to Kafka. In the broker architecture, two systems will consume these updates: the live stock tick system and the historical stock tick system (discussed in the next section). Kafka can handle the expected scale and provides message ordering, guaranteeing that we can meet one of our system requirements. An additional event-ordering mechanism can be built into the client application where the application can discard any old events based on event sequencing.

内部后端服务。消息转发以异步方式完成，方法是把更新发布到 Kafka。在经纪商架构中，将有两个系统消费这些更新：实时股票 tick 系统和历史股票 tick 系统（下一节讨论）。Kafka 能够处理预期规模，并提供消息排序，保证我们能满足其中一项系统需求。还可以在客户端应用中内建一个额外的事件排序机制，应用可以根据事件序列号丢弃任何过期事件。

The stock live ticker service (SLTS) consumes messages from Kafka and delivers them to the end users in real time. The SLTS maintains persistent connections with end user devices and works similarly to the frontend chat servers in the chat application architecture discussed in Chapter 19. The SLTS contains two in-memory tables: one maintaining the stock prices and the other listing users interested in a specific stock. An interesting point to note here is that there are multiple price entries associated with a single stock (depending on the data depth supported by the system) and updated in near real time. These use cases can be solved by using data structures like balanced trees and priority queues of fixed length or by leveraging Redis sorted sets.

股票实时行情服务（SLTS）从 Kafka 消费消息，并实时投递给终端用户。SLTS 与终端用户设备维持持久连接，工作方式类似于第 19 章讨论的聊天应用架构中的前端聊天服务器。SLTS 包含两张内存表：一张维护股价，另一张列出对某只特定股票感兴趣的用户。这里有一个值得注意的有趣点：单只股票关联着多个价格条目（取决于系统支持的数据深度），并且以近实时方式更新。这些用例可以用平衡树和定长优先级队列等数据结构来解决，或者利用 Redis 有序集合。

The stock price table is a global key-value store accessible to all the servers of the SLTS, and connection data is maintained locally by each server, as shown in Figure 21-2.

股价表是一个全局键值存储，SLTS 的所有服务器都可访问；而连接数据由每台服务器在本地维护，如图 21-2 所示。

Let’s talk a little about persistent connections between user devices and SLTS servers. Once the user is authenticated on the application, a persistent connection is established, and a connection ID is generated for the user device. This connection ID is handled by one of the SLTS servers. The server keeps an in-memory table mapping the stock name to a list of connection IDs interested in the stock. If there are any faults on the SLTS server, the user device establishes a new connection with a new connection ID, and a server is assigned to the user for receiving stock updates. A connection ID is managed by a lightweight thread or process of the system, and a single SLTS server is capable of handling thousands (on the order of 100,000) of such connections (benchmarking should be done to figure out the maximum connections that a single server can support). The lightweight thread can be managed by programming-language-specific constructs, such as Akka actors for JVM languages (or recently launched Java virtual threads), goroutines in Go, or processes in Erlang.

下面简单谈谈用户设备与 SLTS 服务器之间的持久连接。用户在应用上一旦通过认证，就建立一条持久连接，并为该用户设备生成一个连接 ID。这个连接 ID 由某台 SLTS 服务器处理。该服务器在内存中维护一张表，把股票名称映射到对该股票感兴趣的连接 ID 列表。如果 SLTS 服务器出现任何故障，用户设备就用新的连接 ID 建立新连接，并为用户分配一台服务器来接收股票更新。一个连接 ID 由系统的一个轻量线程或进程管理，单台 SLTS 服务器能够处理数千个（约 10 万量级）这样的连接（应当做基准测试来确定单台服务器最多能支持多少连接）。轻量线程可以由编程语言特定的构造来管理，例如 JVM 语言的 Akka actor（或最近推出的 Java 虚拟线程）、Go 的 goroutine，或 Erlang 的进程。

Page 570

The live stock updates have these steps: the exchange publishes a stock update; the STCS ingests the update and publishes it to Kafka; the SLTS updates the stock price to a global key-value store (such as Redis); and the SLTS checks for a connection ID interested in the stock and sends the updates to the users’ devices. Thinking ahead, there can be two optimizations possible in the SLTS architecture:

实时股票更新经过以下步骤：交易所发布一条股票更新；STCS 摄入该更新并把它发布到 Kafka；SLTS 把股价更新到一个全局键值存储（例如 Redis）；然后 SLTS 检查对该股票感兴趣的连接 ID，把更新发送到用户设备。往前看，SLTS 架构中可以做两处优化：

  • The SLTS is responsible for two actions: persisting the stock price updates to the global key-value store and maintaining the persistent connections with user devices. We can break this into two service deployments: a Kafka consumer is responsible for consuming the update and updating the stock price, and another service is responsible for delivering the stock updates to end user devices.
    SLTS 负责两个动作：把股价更新持久化到全局键值存储，以及维护与用户设备的持久连接。我们可以把它拆成两个服务部署：一个 Kafka 消费者负责消费更新并更新股价，另一个服务负责把股票更新投递给终端用户设备。
  • The number of stocks listed on the stock exchange is limited, and we can keep a copy of stock prices in memory on the SLTS server. The idea is to keep a hot cache on top of a Redis cache for inferring the stock prices and making the system faster overall. Redis acts as a persistent data store, and the application servers can retrieve the data from Redis on restarts or when a new server is added to the pool.
    在股票交易所上市的股票数量是有限的，我们可以在 SLTS 服务器的内存中保留一份股价副本。这个想法是在 Redis 缓存之上再保留一个热缓存，以推断股价并让系统整体更快。Redis 充当持久数据存储，应用服务器在重启或向连接池添加新服务器时，可以从 Redis 取回数据。

The live stock ticks delivered to users calculate the P&L of user’s stocks in real time and update the dashboard. Now, let’s look into deriving historical market data for the users.

投递给用户的实时股票 tick 会实时计算用户股票的盈亏并更新仪表盘。现在，我们看看如何为用户派生历史市场数据。

Historical stock ticks

The consumer of the historical stock tick service (HSTS) consumes the stock price updates from Kafka and then stores them to the database. The use case of the HSTS is to serve the historical price of a particular stock, so the data should be stored in a database such that we’re able to figure out the stock price at any particular timestamp. We discussed the Amazon Timestream database in Chapter 10; it is the most feasible choice for such use cases. A lot of other time-series database choices are available in the market, such as InfluxDB and ClickHouse, and you should make your choice

历史股票 tick 服务（HSTS）的消费者从 Kafka 消费股价更新，然后把它们存储到数据库。HSTS 的用例是提供某只特定股票的历史价格，因此数据应当以这样一种方式存储在数据库中：我们能够查出任何特定时间戳的股价。我们在第 10 章讨论过 Amazon Timestream 数据库；它是这类用例最可行的选择。市场上还有很多其他时序数据库可选，例如 InfluxDB 和 ClickHouse，你应当基于以往的经验、并为你的用例构建一个概念验证来做选择。

Page 571

based on previous expertise and building a proof of concept for your use case. Like SLTS, the HSTS has two service deployments: one for writing stock price updates and another for serving the user read queries.

与 SLTS 一样，HSTS 有两个服务部署：一个用于写入股价更新，另一个用于服务用户读查询。

Most of the read queries served to the system are for a recent time period, such as one day or one week. There are fewer queries as the period increases to lengths such as one month, one year, or greater than a year. For this kind of query pattern, data archival becomes important to reduce costs associated with older data infrequently accessed by users. Data archival is available inherently in the Timestream database, and we don’t need to configure any manual processes. Timestream comes with two storage tiers: memory store and magnetic store. The memory store can be used to serve the most recent queries. After the configured time period, the data is automatically moved to the magnetic store. We can also configure a retention period on the magnetic store; the data is permanently deleted from the magnetic store after this time.

系统服务的大多数读查询都是针对最近一个时间段，例如一天或一周。随着时间段增长到一个月、一年或一年以上，查询数量会减少。对于这种查询模式，数据归档变得重要，以降低用户不常访问的较旧数据相关的成本。Timestream 数据库原生提供数据归档，我们不需要配置任何手工流程。Timestream 有两个存储层：内存存储和磁性存储。内存存储可用于服务最近的查询。经过配置的时间段后，数据自动移动到磁性存储。我们还可以在磁性存储上配置保留期；超过该时间后数据从磁性存储永久删除。

The user checks for current stock prices and historical trends and then can choose to sell existing stocks or buy new stocks. This is handled by the order management system (OMS).

用户查看当前股价和历史趋势，然后可以选择卖出已持有的股票或买入新股票。这由订单管理系统（OMS）处理。

Designing the Order Management System

We already described the order as a stock buy or sell operation. The OMS converts user interest (stock buy or sell) to an order request and forwards it to the exchange system for execution. The OMS runs a set of prevalidations to ensure that all compliance regulations are met before the request is sent to the exchange system. The validation system or risk management system (RMS) runs as a separate service to ensure independent operations and scaling. The high-level picture of order execution through the OMS is shown in Figure 21-3.

我们已经把订单描述为一次股票买入或卖出操作。OMS 把用户意图（买入或卖出股票）转换成一个订单请求，并把它转发给交易所系统执行。OMS 在把请求发送给交易所系统之前，会运行一组预验证，以确保满足所有合规法规。验证系统或称风险管理系统（RMS）作为独立服务运行，以确保独立运行和独立扩展。通过 OMS 进行订单执行的高层视图如图 21-3 所示。

The responsibility of the OMS can vary depending on the country where the broker application is operating. Here are two segments in which the OMS can operate:

OMS 的职责可能因经纪应用所在国家而异。OMS 可以在以下两个环节中运作：

  • The OMS creates an order request based on user input and passes it to the stock exchange for execution. The exchange system takes responsibility for matching this order against another order (a buy order matched against a sell order; reference the order-matching algorithm used by NSE India) and completing it.
    OMS 基于用户输入创建订单请求，并把它传给股票交易所执行。交易所系统负责把这笔订单与另一笔订单撮合（买单与卖单撮合；参考 NSE India 使用的订单撮合算法）并完成它。
  • The OMS can match the order from the user pool and then forward the matched order to the exchange system.
    OMS 可以在用户池中撮合订单，然后把撮合后的订单转发给交易所系统。
Page 572

The OMS can be self-hosted by the broker system, or third-party solutions can be leveraged. For example, Zerodha uses a combination of self-hosted and third-party OMSs provided by Refinitiv. The third-party OMS generally offers a combination of features, including RMS and connectivity to the exchange systems from the broker systems’ data centers. Let’s take a look at an example architecture at Zerodha to understand end-to-end connectivity using AWS, an on-premises data center, and the exchange system. The users connect to systems via Cloudflare CDN to place orders on a frontend trading application. The trading application communicates with other backend services (such as request validation) and the OMS on an on-premises data center via AWS Direct Connect for faster communication. The on-premises data center communicates with the exchange systems over a dedicated leased line for final order execution, as shown in Figure 21-4.

OMS 可以由经纪商系统自建，也可以利用第三方方案。例如，Zerodha 自建与 Refinitiv 提供的第三方 OMS 相结合。第三方 OMS 通常提供一系列组合功能，包括 RMS，以及从经纪商系统数据中心到交易所系统的连接。让我们看看 Zerodha 的一个示例架构，以理解使用 AWS、本地数据中心和交易所系统的端到端连接。用户通过 Cloudflare CDN 连接到系统，在一个前置交易应用上下单。交易应用通过 AWS Direct Connect 与其他后端服务（例如请求验证）以及本地数据中心上的 OMS 通信，以实现更快通信。本地数据中心通过专用租用线路与交易所系统通信，进行最终订单执行，如图 21-4 所示。

The broker backend application also creates an internal order, which maps to the order created by the exchange system. This internal order maintains a reference to the external exchange order and other relevant details, such as payment details for order processing. The internal order is created with a unique identifier and helps with ensuring idempotency of the request (no duplicate order execution). The stock exchange system replies with acknowledgment of the request being received, and further updates are sent asynchronously for actions taken against the order.

经纪商后端应用还会创建一个内部订单，它映射到交易所系统创建的订单。这个内部订单维护对外部交易所订单的引用，以及其他相关细节，例如用于订单处理的支付细节。内部订单创建时带有一个唯一标识符，有助于确保请求的幂等性（不会重复执行订单）。股票交易所系统回复确认收到该请求，针对订单采取的后续动作则以异步方式发送更新。

In the previous sections, we discussed the choices of database as Redis for live stock prices and a time-series database for serving historical stock price charts. Here are the data store requirements for the internal OMS:

在前面几节中，我们讨论了用 Redis 作为实时股价的数据库、用时序数据库来服务历史股价图表。下面是内部 OMS 的数据存储需求：

  • Create an entry in the database for an order before execution.
    在执行之前为订单在数据库中创建一条记录。
  • Update the entry after acknowledgment is received from the exchange system with details like the order status, timestamp, amount executed by the exchange system (the amount can vary between the time the order was initiated on the broker application and the time the order actually got executed by the exchange system), and exchange order reference.
    在收到交易所系统的确认后，更新该记录，细节包括订单状态、时间戳、交易所系统执行的数量（从订单在经纪应用上发起，到订单实际被交易所系统执行，这段时间内数量可能变化）以及交易所订单引用。

The database should comply with ACID properties and be scalable to handle a high write load (the system is write heavy as compared to reads). Here are a few of the use cases for reads and writes to the database:

数据库应当符合 ACID 特性，并可扩展以处理高写负载（与读相比，系统是写密集型）。下面是数据库读写的几个用例：

  • Create a reference order for an order made by the user.
    为用户下的一笔订单创建一个参考订单。
  • Check the status of an order.
    检查一笔订单的状态。
  • Fetch the user’s tradebook (all the orders processed on behalf of the user by the broker system).
    拉取用户的交易簿（经纪商系统代用户处理的所有订单）。
  • When an order is moved to user holdings (stocks bought by a user) after a fixed time interval (which varies from exchange to exchange), exchange systems generally share files with the details. The system bulk loads this data to the database.
    当一笔订单在固定时间间隔后（因交易所而异）转入用户持仓（用户买入的股票）时，交易所系统通常会共享包含细节的文件。系统把这些数据批量加载到数据库。
  • This is also applicable to orders placed in advance and executed later based on the type: market, limit, or stop-loss.
    这同样适用于预先下达、之后按类型执行的订单：市价、限价或止损。
Page 574

The latency is critical for live order execution, so database I/O reduction is the key to resolving this. An in-memory data store like Redis is used for end-to-end order execution, and the system in parallel persists this data to a disk data store like PostgreSQL. We’ve explored using Amazon DynamoDB for transactional workloads in previous chapters, and we can very well use that here as well. DynamoDB offers predictable response times for point queries on the primary key. In case you choose a nondistributed relational data store, we recommend database sharding, considering the scale requirements we finalized. To start, you can create logical database partitions and then move to actual physical partitions when the need arises. For the stockbroker application, the partitioning can be based on the time range, such as weekly or monthly.

实时订单执行时延迟至关重要，因此减少数据库 I/O 是解决之道的关键。像 Redis 这样的内存数据存储用于端到端订单执行，系统同时把这些数据持久化到 PostgreSQL 这样的磁盘数据存储。我们在前面几章探讨过把 Amazon DynamoDB 用于事务工作负载，这里同样可以很好地使用它。DynamoDB 对主键上的点查提供可预测的响应时间。如果你选择非分布式关系数据存储，考虑到我们确定的规模需求，建议对数据库分片。起步时，你可以创建逻辑数据库分区，之后在需要时再迁移到实际的物理分区。对于股票经纪商应用，分区可以基于时间范围，例如每周或每月。

Low latency is one of the NFRs we discussed in “System Requirements” on page 544. As mentioned previously, the stockbroker application doesn’t target microsecond-magnitude latency like HFT firms do. Latency should definitely be in the submilliseconds, though, so that users don’t see delays when viewing the stock prices. Let’s discuss a few of the aspects related to ultra-low-latency systems.

低延迟是我们在第 544 页“系统需求”中讨论过的 NFR 之一。如前所述，股票经纪商应用并不像 HFT 公司那样以微秒级延迟为目标。不过延迟绝对应当在亚毫秒级，这样用户查看股价时才不会看到延迟。下面我们讨论与超低延迟系统相关的几个方面。

Designing Ultra-Low-Latency Systems

Achieving extremely low latency like HFTs do is not feasible for broker applications due to the way the systems are architected. The broker applications connect to users on the public network as opposed to any dedicated network, which adds extra latency in data delivery. In the context of HFT system requirements, the system should be able to ingest TBT market data, run some algorithms to figure out an action (buy a stock, sell a stock, or no action), and execute an order per the evaluation. This whole process should take the minimum possible time to achieve maximum market gains.

由于系统架构方式的原因，经纪商应用要像 HFT 那样实现极低延迟并不可行。经纪应用通过公网（而非任何专用网络）连接用户，这在数据投递中增加了额外延迟。在 HFT 系统需求的语境下，系统应当能够摄入 TBT 市场数据、运行某些算法来判断一个动作（买入股票、卖出股票或不动作），并根据评估执行订单。整个过程应花尽可能少的时间，以实现最大的市场收益。

The HFT system’s architecture is similar to direct connectivity between broker application on-premises data centers and exchange systems over a dedicated network. Let’s discuss a few of the techniques that HFTs employ to achieve ultra-low latency in systems, starting with network connectivity between different components.

HFT 系统的架构类似于经纪应用本地数据中心与交易所系统之间通过专用网络的直接连接。下面我们讨论 HFT 用于在系统中实现超低延迟的几个技术，从不同组件之间的网络连接开始。

Network connectivity

There is dedicated network connectivity between HFT systems and the exchange systems to avoid any issues related to network bandwidth. The exchange system requires that the leased lines used have the same capabilities for all the HFTs to ensure fairness among all the firms. The HFT backend system consists of multiple microservices, and there is connectivity involved in these services as well. A network call to another service could add to the latency, so this is not a feasible approach; the microservices should be executed in shared memory for ultra-fast processing. Aeron clusters and Chronicle queues are a couple of the solutions that can be used to achieve this in a fault-tolerant manner. Another consideration for

HFT 系统与交易所系统之间有专用网络连接，以避免任何与网络带宽相关的问题。交易所系统要求所用租用线路对所有 HFT 具有相同能力，以确保所有公司之间的公平。HFT 后端系统由多个微服务组成，这些服务之间也涉及连接。对另一个服务的网络调用会增加延迟，因此这不是一个可行的方法；微服务应当在共享内存中执行，以实现超高速处理。Aeron 集群和 Chronicle 队列是可以以容错方式实现这一点的两个方案。低延迟系统的另一个考虑

Page 575

low-latency systems is managing hardware resources for executing programs. The program thread should not wait for resources or get blocked on any other thread for execution. To solve this, HFT software systems tend to rely on single-threaded systems with no thread-synchronization requirements.

是管理用于执行程序的硬件资源。程序线程不应等待资源，也不应因任何其他线程而阻塞执行。为解决这一点，HFT 软件系统倾向于依赖单线程系统，不需要线程同步。

Evaluate business use cases carefully to figure out the most feasible architecture. A single-threaded execution makes sense for HFT software systems, while huge lightweight threads are helpful in chat systems (refer to Chapter 19).
仔细评估业务用例，找出最可行的架构。单线程执行对 HFT 软件系统是合理的，而海量轻量线程在聊天系统中很有帮助（参见第 19 章）。

These are some of the ways to improve network connectivity among HFT systems. The next important consideration is the choice of programming language; some languages offer inherently faster code execution compared to others, and that becomes very important for latency-critical applications.

这些是改善 HFT 系统之间网络连接的一些方法。下一个重要考虑是编程语言的选择；有些语言天生比其他语言提供更快的代码执行，这对延迟关键的应用非常重要。

Programming language

The design can be incredibly good, but if the programming language does other stuff along with code execution, then it adds to the latency. One such popular example of additional work is GC. We talked about how GC can affect system performance in previous chapters, such as tombstones in Apache Cassandra, and you need to figure out a way to get around this for languages like Java. The idea is to have maximum control over how the code is being executed on the hardware to optimize to a magnitude of microseconds. This ideology is similar to using AWS fully managed services versus taking the operational overhead on your own plate. To avoid GC issues, you can choose programming languages like C and C++, but they come with memory-management overhead.

设计可以极其出色，但如果编程语言在执行代码的同时还做别的事情，就会增加延迟。这类额外工作一个流行的例子就是 GC（垃圾回收）。我们在前面几章谈过 GC 如何影响系统性能，例如 Apache Cassandra 中的墓碑；对于 Java 这类语言，你需要找到绕开它的办法。其思路是对代码在硬件上如何执行拥有最大程度的控制，以优化到微秒量级。这种理念类似于使用 AWS 全托管服务 vs. 自己承担运维开销。为避免 GC 问题，你可以选择 C 和 C++ 等编程语言，但它们自带内存管理开销。

There are pros and cons associated with all programming languages that will need thorough analysis before choosing one. For example, if we go ahead with a JVM language like Java, the GC issues can be addressed with the following techniques:

所有编程语言都各有利弊，在选择之前需要透彻分析。例如，如果我们选用 Java 这样的 JVM 语言，GC 问题可以通过以下技术解决：

  • Leverage technologies such as Azul Platform Prime that inherently improve the Java code efficiency.
    利用 Azul Platform Prime 这类天生提高 Java 代码效率的技术。
  • Introduce programming techniques that don’t require GC, such as using off-heap memory (memory allocated to the OS outside the purview of JVM), warming up the code before the market opens, or preallocating memory to the pool (no allocation or deletion requirement at runtime). Preallocation is much like using an already established persistent connection instead of reinitiating a TCP handshake every time.
    引入不需要 GC 的编程技术，例如使用堆外内存（在 JVM 管辖之外分配给 OS 的内存）、在开盘前预热代码，或向内存池预分配内存（运行时无需分配或释放）。预分配很像使用一条已经建立好的持久连接，而不是每次都重新发起 TCP 握手。

There are other choices, such as FPGA and application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC), which are faster than Java or C++, but these choices are difficult to program

还有其他选择，例如 FPGA 和专用集成电路（ASIC），它们比 Java 或 C++ 更快，但这些选择难以编程，

Page 576

and come with their own set of problems. For example, FPGA takes between around 30 minutes and 30 hours for compilation, depending on the program’s complexity and the machine type, increasing the deployment time for any critical bug fixes.

并自带一系列问题。例如，FPGA 编译大约需要 30 分钟到 30 小时不等，取决于程序复杂度和机器类型，这增加了任何关键 bug 修复的部署时间。

The best architectures perform well on the best hardware, so choosing hardware configurations is equally as important as making software architecture decisions. A lot of options are available from the cloud providers to run HFT software, such as Amazon EC2 z1d instances for fast single-threaded execution.

最好的架构要在最好的硬件上才能表现出色，因此选择硬件配置与做软件架构决策同等重要。云服务商提供很多选项来运行 HFT 软件，例如用于快速单线程执行的 Amazon EC2 z1d 实例。

Once you’ve viewed the stocks based on live stock ticks and historical stocks charts and placed an order, the next action is viewing your P&L dashboard and other analytics on top of it.

一旦你基于实时股票 tick 和历史股票图表查看了股票并下了订单，下一个动作就是查看你的盈亏仪表盘以及其上的其他分析。

Building the P&L Dashboard

The P&L dashboard shows the user’s stock holdings at any point in time, which consists of the P&L of each individual stock as well as the overall portfolio. The P&L dashboard should also be updated in real time based on the stock ticks we discussed in “Live stock ticks” on page 547. The real-time update logic can be handled in the client-facing application itself based on the events received over the persistent connection.

盈亏仪表盘在任何时刻都展示用户的股票持仓，包括每只个股的盈亏以及整体投资组合。盈亏仪表盘还应当基于我们在第 547 页“实时股票 tick”中讨论的股票 tick 实时更新。实时更新逻辑可以在面向客户端的应用本身处理，基于通过持久连接收到的事件。

The P&L dashboard is derived data from the order execution database (the user tradebook). The idea is to maintain this separately as user holdings instead of computing it at runtime because it is frequently accessed by the users. The calculation of P&L is pretty simple and can be done in these two steps:

盈亏仪表盘是从订单执行数据库（用户交易簿）派生出来的数据。其思路是把它作为用户持仓单独维护，而不是在运行时计算，因为用户会频繁访问它。盈亏的计算相当简单，可以分两步完成：

  1. Get all the stock holdings of a user.
    获取用户的所有股票持仓。
  2. Subtract the summation of all the sell orders from the summation of all the buy orders for each of these stocks.
    对每只这样的股票，从所有买单总额中减去所有卖单总额。

The logic is simple, but the trades can span years; for example, you sell 50% of your stock holdings, which were bought five years ago. This makes derivation of data difficult and is the main reason to perform the operation during off-market hours. One important point to note here is that users’ holdings don’t change throughout the day but are settled at the end of the day by the exchange systems.

逻辑很简单，但交易可能跨越数年；例如你卖出五年前买入的股票持仓的 50%。这使得数据派生变得困难，也是在非交易时间执行该操作的主要原因。这里需要注意的一个重要点是：用户持仓在当天内并不变化，而是由交易所系统在当天结束时进行结算。

Page 577

Let’s illustrate a simplified schema with Amazon DynamoDB. The following schema is a simple example that gets all stocks for the userId with their P&L:

让我们用 Amazon DynamoDB 举例说明一个简化 schema。下面这个 schema 是一个简单示例，用于获取某个 userId 的所有股票及其盈亏：

  • Partition key = {userId}
    分区键 = {userId}
  • Sort key for overall P&L = PL
    整体盈亏的排序键 = PL
  • Sort key for each stock = S#{stockName}
    每只股票的排序键 = S#{stockName}

We can also maintain the overall P&L in the same table by keeping the same partition key and distinguishing the sort key by an additional prefix.

我们也可以在同一张表中维护整体盈亏，方法是保持相同的分区键，并通过额外前缀区分排序键。

This schema is for illustrative purposes only. The same table may consist of other entities to solve different query patterns. Older data can be archived to S3 based on configured TTL or moved to DynamoDB standard IA from standard mode, optimizing the storage costs. Standard IA has increased read and write costs, but again it is designed for infrequent access and achieves 60% cost optimization on storage.
这个 schema 仅作示例。同一张表可能包含其他实体，以解决不同的查询模式。较旧的数据可以基于配置的 TTL 归档到 S3，或从标准模式移动到 DynamoDB Standard-IA，以优化存储成本。Standard-IA 的读写成本更高，但它是为不频繁访问而设计的，在存储上可实现 60% 的成本优化。

We can create similar tables in RDBMS as well to support all the P&L use cases. Taking an example from the Zerodha broker application, the console application (the service responsible for handling P&L) creates a PostgreSQL caching layer on top of the primary PostgreSQL database (bulk updated based on files received from the exchange at the end of the day during off-market hours). The caching PostgreSQL creates millions of tables for the users to maintain their holdings, which are updated every day based on the trades completed for the day.

我们也可以在 RDBMS 中创建类似的表来支持所有盈亏用例。以 Zerodha 经纪应用为例，console 应用（负责处理盈亏的服务）在主 PostgreSQL 数据库之上创建了一个 PostgreSQL 缓存层（在非交易时间根据当天结束时从交易所收到的文件批量更新）。这个缓存 PostgreSQL 为用户创建了数百万张表来维护其持仓，每天根据当天完成的交易更新。

The AWS blog describes how Zerodha systems perform P&L calculations during off-market hours using the AWS Batch service. Batch is a fully managed batch computing service to schedule and run heavy workloads on a range of AWS compute services: Amazon EC2, Amazon ECS, and Amazon EKS.
AWS 博客描述了 Zerodha 系统如何使用 AWS Batch 服务在非交易时间执行盈亏计算。Batch 是一个全托管批处理计算服务，用于在一系列 AWS 计算服务（Amazon EC2、Amazon ECS 和 Amazon EKS）上调度和运行重负载作业。

Different analytics are also offered by the broker application, and they can best be served by using an analytical database like Amazon Redshift and building a dashboard with solutions like Metabase or Amazon QuickSight. The key consideration for analytical queries is that we can survive with a little lag in serving the response, but it should not be too large (less than five seconds).

经纪应用还提供不同的分析功能，这些分析最好使用 Amazon Redshift 这样的分析数据库来服务，并用 Metabase 或 Amazon QuickSight 之类的方案构建仪表盘。分析查询的关键考虑是：我们可以容忍响应服务有一点延迟，但延迟不应太大（少于 5 秒）。

Now, let’s move to the deployment of the architectures we discussed on the AWS cloud.

现在，我们转向把讨论过的架构部署到 AWS 云上。

Launching the System on AWS

We took various architecture references in the previous sections from Zerodha’s systems. Zerodha self-hosts most of its services on bare-metal EC2 instances for full control over infrastructure tuning and management. As we have reiterated, every decision in the system-design process is a trade-off, and it’s important that you understand the reasoning for how a decision aligns with the business use case. An important consideration in systems like online broker applications is that there are compliance regulations in place that should be adhered to from day one. We’ll start with the Day 0 architecture on the AWS cloud to launch the systems quickly and then move toward scaling and coming up with a highly scalable architecture.

我们在前面几节中从 Zerodha 系统借鉴了各种架构参考。Zerodha 把大部分服务自建在裸金属 EC2 实例上，以完全控制基础设施的调优和管理。正如我们反复强调的，系统设计过程中的每个决策都是一次取舍，重要的是你理解决策如何与业务用例相一致的理由。在线经纪应用这类系统的一个重要考虑是：存在合规法规，应当从第一天起就遵守。我们将从 AWS 云上的 Day 0 架构开始，快速启动系统，然后走向扩展并提出一个高度可扩展的架构。

Day 0 Architecture

The Day 0 architecture should be modular such that compliance regulations can be easily addressed and don’t become a blocker in software development. Another benefit of modular architecture is breaking a single service into multiple microservices later down the line with ease. We explored using AWS AppSync in Chapter 19 for creating persistent connections and supporting delivery of user messages in near real time. The broker application has a requirement for delivering stock ticks, so a similar implementation can be used here.

Day 0 架构应当是模块化的，这样合规法规就能轻松应对，而不会成为软件开发的阻碍。模块化架构的另一个好处是，之后可以轻松地把单个服务拆成多个微服务。我们在第 19 章探讨过使用 AWS AppSync 创建持久连接、并支持近实时投递用户消息。经纪应用有投递股票 tick 的需求，因此这里可以使用类似的实现。

The system requirements state that the system is heavily accessed by the users during market hours, and then the customer-facing traffic drops exponentially. AppSync automatically scales per the required connections and doesn’t require a manual intervention (refer to the AWS blog for implementation using AppSync and Amazon MSK). The systems leverage third-party systems like LSEG Data & Analytics for consumption of live market data. The market data streams are consumed at an NLB endpoint and distributed among the Amazon ECS Fargate tasks. The ECS Fargate ingestors publish this data to MSK, which is streamed to AppSync for data delivery to users over persistent connections. The market data from MSK is also consumed by another stock ticker consumer for ingestion to an Amazon Timestream database to serve historical market data queries. There are separate modules for ingesting the data and serving user queries, as shown in Figure 21-5.

系统需求表明，系统在交易时间被用户大量访问，之后面向客户的流量指数级下降。AppSync 按所需连接数自动扩缩，无需人工干预（参见使用 AppSync 和 Amazon MSK 的 AWS 博客）。系统利用 LSEG Data & Analytics 等第三方系统来消费实时市场数据。市场数据流在一个 NLB 端点被消费，并分发到各个 Amazon ECS Fargate 任务。ECS Fargate 摄入器把这些数据发布到 MSK，MSK 再把它流式传输到 AppSync，通过持久连接投递给用户。来自 MSK 的市场数据还被另一个股票行情消费者消费，摄入到 Amazon Timestream 数据库，以服务历史市场数据查询。摄入数据和服务用户查询是分开的模块，如图 21-5 所示。

The next part is allowing users to place an order for a stock listed on the exchange. The Day 0 architecture should also be built keeping low latency in mind—it may not be as low as 50−100 ms but should definitely be under one second. The broker system leverages the third-party OMS, such as Refinitiv (acquired by LSEG), and uses AWS Direct Connect for communication between applications hosted in the AWS cloud and Refinitiv servers. The internal trading service handles the user’s order request, validates the request via the rule management service, and forwards the request to the Refinitiv OMS upon validation. The OMS talks with the exchange systems for

下一部分是允许用户为在交易所上市的某只股票下单。Day 0 架构在构建时也应牢记低延迟——它可能低不到 50−100 ms，但绝对应当在一秒以内。经纪商系统利用第三方 OMS，例如 Refinitiv（已被 LSEG 收购），并使用 AWS Direct Connect 在 AWS 云上托管的应用与 Refinitiv 服务器之间通信。内部交易服务处理用户的订单请求，通过规则管理服务验证请求，并在验证通过后把请求转发给 Refinitiv OMS。OMS 与交易所系统通信，进行

order matching and execution, as shown in Figure 21-6. The acknowledgment to this request is captured and reflected to the customer.

订单撮合和执行，如图 21-6 所示。对该请求的确认会被捕获并反映给客户。

The internal trading service uses Amazon Aurora to persist the order entries and publishes events for the order status to be consumed by services like the dashboard service (responsible for computing user P&L and other analytics). The dashboard service uses Amazon Redshift to offer different kinds of analytics.

内部交易服务使用 Amazon Aurora 持久化订单记录，并发布订单状态事件，供仪表盘服务（负责计算用户盈亏和其他分析）等服务消费。仪表盘服务使用 Amazon Redshift 提供不同种类的分析。

Page 580

Scaling to Millions and Beyond

The customer-facing traffic mostly occurs during market hours, so autoscaling plays an important role in saving overall infrastructure costs. Apart from the customer traffic, multiple offline jobs run during off-market hours, such as sending PDFs to users for trades done during the day, settling orders based on files received from exchange systems, and calculating users’ P&Ls after the settlement cycle. These jobs are not latency critical and can be performed at their own pace, keeping a balance of cost and execution time.

面向客户的流量主要发生在交易时间，因此自动扩缩容在节省整体基础设施成本方面扮演重要角色。除客户流量外，非交易时间还运行多个离线作业，例如把当天交易的 PDF 发送给用户、根据从交易所系统收到的文件结算订单，以及在结算周期后计算用户盈亏。这些作业不是延迟关键的，可以按自己的节奏执行，在成本和执行时间之间保持平衡。

A key consideration for ensuring low latency is keeping the systems in close vicinity (less physical distance). For example, the trading application should be close to the end users to reduce the network hops for connections; the OMS should be close to the exchange systems for faster order execution; and the backend applications should be colocated, avoiding network hops.

确保低延迟的一个关键考虑是让系统彼此靠近（物理距离更短）。例如，交易应用应当靠近终端用户，以减少连接的网络跳数；OMS 应当靠近交易所系统，以更快地执行订单；后端应用应当同址部署，避免网络跳数。

Here are some other considerations for ensuring low latency for the customer-facing systems:

下面是确保面向客户系统低延迟的其他一些考虑：

Prewarm infrastructure

AWS offers scheduled scaling capability, allowing the system to autoscale based on a configured clock time. This ensures that the system is ready to serve the traffic and requests don’t wait in a queue for execution. AWS also provides warm pools for applications that take a longer boot time and could be useful for autoscaling quickly for any unplanned sudden traffic burst or hardware failures on running systems. We recommend keeping the application binary to the absolute minimum, keeping it lightweight (fewer external dependencies and small module-based services) without overburdening it with a lot of implementation logic.

AWS 提供计划扩缩容能力，允许系统根据配置的时钟时间自动扩缩。这确保系统已准备好服务流量，请求不会在队列中等待执行。AWS 还为启动时间较长的应用提供预热池（warm pool），对于任何计划外的突发流量或运行系统上的硬件故障，可用于快速自动扩缩。我们建议把应用二进制保持在绝对最小，使其轻量（更少的外部依赖、小型的基于模块的服务），不要用大量实现逻辑使其过度臃肿。

Cross-AZ deployments

We generally recommend deploying the infrastructure across the AZs in a region for higher application reliability and to withstand AZ downtimes, but this can add to the latency. For example, an internal trading service instance in us-east-1a connects with an RMS instance in us-east-1b for validation; this could have been faster if both services were located in the same AZ. This is only recommended for services with requirements for very low latency because the AWS AZs and regions are connected by dedicated networks, and by default, it takes very little time (this is similar to an EC2 instance connecting with an instance store versus EBS volumes). The system should have a disaster-recovery mechanism for AZ or region downtimes.

我们通常建议把基础设施跨一个区域内的多个 AZ 部署，以获得更高的应用可靠性并承受 AZ 停机，但这会增加延迟。例如，us-east-1a 中的一个内部交易服务实例与 us-east-1b 中的一个 RMS 实例连接以进行验证；如果两个服务位于同一 AZ，本可以更快。只对要求极低延迟的服务才建议这样做，因为 AWS 的 AZ 和区域之间通过专用网络连接，默认耗时非常少（这类似于 EC2 实例连接实例存储 vs. EBS 卷）。系统应当有针对 AZ 或区域停机的灾难恢复机制。

Page 581

VPC connectivity

The VPC can span multiple AZs and host the infrastructure in different AZs based on the subnet, as we discussed in Chapter 9. Let’s say we decide to host the infrastructure in a single AZ: do the applications span multiple VPCs or belong to the same VPC? Hosting in a single VPC can be an ideal scenario for minimum latency with the assumption that multiple VPCs (in the same or separate AWS accounts) are needed for clear division. The VPC connectivity becomes important for such scenarios, and we recommend VPC peering over AWS Transit Gateways to reduce a network hop and decrease latency.

VPC 可以跨多个 AZ，并根据子网把基础设施托管在不同 AZ，正如我们在第 9 章讨论的。假设我们决定把基础设施托管在单个 AZ：应用是跨多个 VPC，还是属于同一个 VPC？在假设为了清晰划分而需要多个 VPC（在相同或不同 AWS 账户中）的情况下，托管在单个 VPC 可以是延迟最低的理想场景。在这类场景下，VPC 连接变得重要，我们推荐用 VPC 对等连接而非 AWS Transit Gateway，以减少一个网络跳数并降低延迟。

EC2 placement groups

There are multiple server racks in the AZ, and the different microservices can be present on different racks, adding to the latency. AWS offers an EC2 placement groups feature, which ensures that the EC2 machines allocated to you belong to the same server rack. This strategy goes against the general recommendation of spreading out the hardware to avoid correlated failures, but it makes sense for achieving low latency in systems. If the applications are deployed on multiple racks to increase resiliency, the system architecture should ensure that there is no cross-rack connectivity and each microservice has its binary deployed on all the racks. To avoid system downtimes, the disaster-recovery strategy becomes important, such as multiple on-premises data centers deployed with AWS Outposts.

一个 AZ 内有多个服务器机架，不同微服务可能位于不同机架上，从而增加延迟。AWS 提供 EC2 置放群组功能，确保分配给你的 EC2 机器属于同一个服务器机架。这一策略与“分散硬件以避免关联故障”的一般建议相悖，但对于在系统中实现低延迟是合理的。如果应用部署在多个机架上以提高弹性，系统架构应当确保没有跨机架连接，并且每个微服务的二进制都部署在所有机架上。为避免系统停机，灾难恢复策略变得重要，例如用 AWS Outposts 部署多个本地数据中心。

Hardware selection

AWS offers a wide range of instance types, and choosing the best for the workload determines the execution latency; we recommend proper benchmarking to come up with the best instance configurations. EBS volumes used for the workload play equally important roles, and AWS Nitro SSD volumes are helpful in achieving submillisecond latency.

AWS 提供广泛的实例类型，为工作负载选择最合适的实例决定了执行延迟；我们建议做恰当的基准测试以得出最佳实例配置。用于工作负载的 EBS 卷同样扮演重要角色，AWS Nitro SSD 卷有助于实现亚毫秒级延迟。

Data caching

Database reads can introduce I/O bottlenecks, adding to the execution latency. In-memory data stores can be more helpful for achieving low latency. These data stores can be used as a caching layer on top of persistent disk stores or used as a primary data store (with a disk-persistence option to avoid data loss) for hot paths such as order execution. We also recommend using Amazon CloudFront wherever feasible for caching the content near the end users.

数据库读可能引入 I/O 瓶颈，增加执行延迟。内存数据存储对实现低延迟更有帮助。这些数据存储可以用作持久磁盘存储之上的缓存层，或用作主数据存储（带磁盘持久化选项以避免数据丢失），用于订单执行等热路径。我们还建议在可行之处使用 Amazon CloudFront，把内容缓存在靠近终端用户的地方。

AWS edge infrastructure

We mentioned that latency can be reduced by reducing the distance, but one of the places we don’t have control is the public internet. Customers connecting to broker application servers through the public internet can introduce unwanted network latency; this can be further reduced by using AWS Local Zones (discussed in Chapter 9). Local Zones enable us to place the infrastructure

我们提到可以通过缩短距离来降低延迟，但我们无法控制的地方之一就是公网。通过公网连接到经纪应用服务器的客户可能引入不必要的网络延迟；这可以通过使用 AWS Local Zones（第 9 章讨论）进一步降低。Local Zones 使我们能够把基础设施

Page 582

much closer to the customers compared to AWS regions and are very helpful in latency-sensitive applications. AWS Wavelength is another edge infrastructure that is helpful for deploying infrastructure to the edge of the telecommunication carrier’s 5G networks. This allows for faster communication with 5G-enabled devices. We might not be able to get the best out of it at present, but this will be helpful in the future when most devices are 5G enabled. There is a possibility that Local and Wavelength Zones are still not near the end customers; for these use cases, AWS Outposts is the solution. AWS Outposts allow customers to extend the AWS infrastructure to their on-premises data centers and connect directly to AWS regions using AWS Direct Connect.

比 AWS 区域更靠近客户，在延迟敏感的应用中非常有帮助。AWS Wavelength 是另一种边缘基础设施，有助于把基础设施部署到电信运营商 5G 网络的边缘。这允许与支持 5G 的设备更快通信。我们目前可能还无法充分发挥它的作用，但将来大多数设备都支持 5G 时它会很有帮助。Local Zone 和 Wavelength Zone 有可能仍不在终端客户附近；对于这些用例，AWS Outposts 是解决方案。AWS Outposts 允许客户把 AWS 基础设施扩展到自己的本地数据中心，并使用 AWS Direct Connect 直接连接到 AWS 区域。

We’ve discussed multiple ways to optimize latency via the AWS infrastructure here. Regular evaluation of the software will help you identify the processes consuming more execution time. Figuring out the exact places where the software is taking more time can help identify a path forward and fix the issue. For example, you might want to denormalize the data to avoid unnecessary joins and improve the query performance; consider using Protobuf or Simple Binary Encoding (SBE) instead of JSON/XML to transfer payload over the network. Another general recommendation for ensuring overall system health is to avoid any deployments or infrastructure-configuration modifications (unless it is a critical requirement) during market hours.

我们在这里讨论了通过 AWS 基础设施优化延迟的多种方法。定期评估软件将帮助你识别消耗更多执行时间的进程。弄清楚软件究竟在哪些地方耗时更多，有助于找到前进方向并修复问题。例如，你可能想对数据反规范化以避免不必要的 join、提高查询性能；考虑使用 Protobuf 或 Simple Binary Encoding（SBE）而非 JSON/XML 在网络上传输载荷。另一条确保整体系统健康的一般建议是：在交易时间避免任何部署或基础设施配置修改（除非是关键需求）。

Looking back at the architectures in Figures 21-5 and 21-6, we can see that we skipped some functionalities and focused on only the core components of how users buy and sell stocks. Other components include the following:

回顾图 21-5 和图 21-6 中的架构，可以看到我们跳过了一些功能，只聚焦于用户如何买卖股票的核心组件。其他组件包括：

User onboarding service

Onboards the user to the stockbroker based on country and stock exchange compliance. This service is similar to the property onboarding architecture discussed in Chapter 18 where the user is onboarding in a set of steps, so we can leverage solutions like Step Functions.

根据国家和股票交易所合规要求，把用户接入股票经纪商。该服务类似于第 18 章讨论的房源接入架构，用户按一组步骤接入，因此我们可以利用 Step Functions 之类的方案。

Payments service

Handles fund transfers from the user’s preferred payment option to a broker account, which can later be used to buy stocks. This service also transfers funds back to the user’s account if stocks are sold or if the user-added funds stay in the broker account too long (per the country’s compliance regulations).

处理资金从用户偏好的支付方式转账到经纪商账户，之后可用于买股票。如果卖出股票，或者用户充入的资金在经纪商账户中停留过久（按国家合规法规），该服务还会把资金转回用户账户。

User authentication service

Authenticates the user requests for all the operations that can be performed on the broker application.

对用户在经纪应用上可执行的所有操作请求进行认证。

The stock exchanges share the market order updates at the end of the day with the broker application via different mechanisms. The mechanism can be a callback posted on our system endpoint or a file with all the data. This can vary from exchange

股票交易所在当天结束时通过不同机制与经纪应用分享市场订单更新。该机制可以是 POST 到我们系统端点的回调，也可以是包含所有数据的文件。这因交易所

to exchange. The broker system takes the following actions based on the updates received from the exchange systems:

而异。经纪商系统根据从交易所系统收到的更新采取以下动作：

  • Compute P&L for the users.
    为用户计算盈亏。
  • Update the user tradebook.

It’s important to note that the stockbroker application can offer stock listings from different stock exchange platforms. The network connectivity will be somewhat similar, but the rules that the RMS holds or the deployment of the OMS can be different. We recommend operating under the assumption that the stock exchange platforms can vary, such as in the ways that the exchange and broker systems communicate; the broker system gathers market updates from the exchange systems; and the orders are executed. This will help you address any specific future tasks for different stock exchange systems. We’ll design the system in the next section keeping separate deployments for the RMS and OMS mapped to a stock exchange.

需要注意的是，股票经纪商应用可以提供来自不同股票交易所平台的股票行情。网络连接会大致相似，但 RMS 持有的规则或 OMS 的部署可能不同。我们建议在“股票交易所平台可能不同”的假设下运作，例如交易所与经纪系统通信的方式、经纪系统从交易所系统收集市场更新的方式以及订单执行方式都可能不同。这将帮助你应对未来针对不同股票交易所系统的任何特定任务。下一节我们设计系统时，会为每个股票交易所保留独立的 RMS 和 OMS 部署。

To also help with scale, developer dependency should be minimized with respect to operations tasks, such as adding or modifying rules in the RMS. The RMS should expose a portal for the operations team to access and modify the rule set. Additionally, the system should have some type of mechanism for testing these rules in the staging environment before they can be moved to the production environment (with a percentage-based rollout strategy). The storage solution maintaining the rules should keep versions of the rule configs as they are modified over time. Any created order should have a rule-config version associated with it. This helps create an audit history to verify the rules executed by the system for successful validation before allowing a trade to happen.

为了也帮助扩展，应当尽量减少开发人员对运维任务的依赖，例如在 RMS 中添加或修改规则。RMS 应当暴露一个门户，供运维团队访问和修改规则集。此外，系统应当有某种机制，在把这些规则移到生产环境之前（采用基于百分比的灰度发布策略）在 staging 环境中测试它们。维护规则的存储方案应当随时间修改保留规则配置的版本。任何创建的订单都应关联一个规则配置版本。这有助于创建审计历史，以验证系统在允许一笔交易发生之前成功验证所执行的规则。

Let’s move to Day N architecture on the AWS cloud next.

下面我们转向 AWS 云上的 Day N 架构。

Day N Architecture

In the Day 0 architecture, we used Refinitiv and LSEG as placeholder systems for the OMS and for retrieving live market data needs. The third-party systems are ideally designed for the scale. These systems are used for illustrative purposes only, and we don’t recommend integrating these systems in your architecture. Analyze different solutions available in the industry (or developing a custom solution) to determine what works best for your organization. Involvement of on-premises data centers in the overall architecture also depends on the country and stock exchange compliance regulations. Some stock exchanges restrict the broker applications to only connect to stock exchanges from an on-premises data center via dedicated leased lines (as in Figure 21-4).

在 Day 0 架构中，我们使用 Refinitiv 和 LSEG 作为 OMS 和实时市场数据需求的占位系统。第三方系统在理想情况下就是为规模而设计的。这些系统仅作示例使用，我们不建议把这些系统集成到你的架构中。分析行业中可用的不同方案（或开发定制方案），以确定什么最适合你的组织。整体架构中是否涉及本地数据中心，也取决于国家和股票交易所的合规法规。有些股票交易所限制经纪应用只能通过专用租用线路从本地数据中心连接到股票交易所（如图 21-4）。

Page 584

To start scaling the system to more live, concurrent users, we’ll split the architecture discussion into two parts: the system serving live and historical market data and the system responsible for executing orders.

为开始把系统扩展到更多实时并发用户，我们把架构讨论分为两部分：服务实时和历史市场数据的系统，以及负责执行订单的系统。

Market data delivery

For the requirements of both the live market data and the order execution systems, we’ll rely on the colocation space offered by the stock exchanges (e.g., Nasdaq). This will help reduce overall network hops, optimizing latency and removing dependency on third-party vendors wherever possible. Further, streaming TBT market data to all the clients consumes a lot of bandwidth, so ideally, exchanges stream up to level 2 data (approximately three ticks per second). For use cases to serve level 3 and TBT data, broker applications are required to host their servers in colocation space and consume the TBT data streams.

对于实时市场数据和订单执行系统两者的需求，我们将依赖股票交易所（例如 Nasdaq）提供的托管空间。这有助于减少整体网络跳数，优化延迟，并在可能的地方消除对第三方供应商的依赖。此外，向所有客户端流式传输 TBT 市场数据会消耗大量带宽，因此理想情况下，交易所只流式传输到 level 2 数据（约每秒 3 个 tick）。对于要服务 level 3 和 TBT 数据的用例，经纪应用需要把服务器托管在托管空间中，并消费 TBT 数据流。

The broker server colocated in the stock exchange data center consumes the TBT market data, transforms the TBT data to level 3 data, compresses the level 3 data, and streams the data to an on-premises data center via a dedicated leased line. From the on-premises data center, the data is streamed to AWS regions via AWS Direct Connect and delivered to users via the SLTS over a persistent WebSocket connection. The on-premises data center is introduced in between with the assumption that the stock exchange mandates this per regulations. In case this is not mandated, the data can be streamed from the stock exchange to the AWS region directly via Direct Connect. The overall architecture with live and historical stock ticks is shown in Figure 21-7; networking components like gateways, LBs, and the edge cache are skipped to keep the diagram simple.

托管在股票交易所数据中心的经纪服务器消费 TBT 市场数据，把 TBT 数据转换为 level 3 数据，压缩 level 3 数据，并通过专用租用线路把数据流式传输到本地数据中心。从本地数据中心，数据通过 AWS Direct Connect 流式传输到 AWS 区域，并由 SLTS 通过持久 WebSocket 连接投递给用户。中间引入本地数据中心的前提是股票交易所按规定要求这样做。如果没有此要求，数据可以通过 Direct Connect 直接从股票交易所流式传输到 AWS 区域。带实时和历史股票 tick 的整体架构如图 21-7 所示；为保持图简单，网关、LB 和边缘缓存等网络组件被略去。

In this architecture, we assumed that the stock exchange servers are hosted in a self-managed data center. Nowadays, stock exchanges are also migrating to the cloud to host the infrastructure and reduce operational burden. Even with on-premises data centers, stock exchanges are trying to leverage services like AWS Local Zones, which can help achieve the benefits of the cloud in the self-hosted data centers.

在这个架构中，我们假设股票交易所服务器托管在自建数据中心。如今，股票交易所也在向云端迁移以托管基础设施并减少运维负担。即使有本地数据中心，股票交易所也在尝试利用 AWS Local Zones 之类的服务，这有助于在自建数据中心中获得云的好处。

Page 585

Market order execution

The flow of requests in market order execution systems is opposite the flow in market data delivery systems. The request starts with the user, with an intent to execute an order. The stockbroker system validates the request for execution and forwards the request to the stock exchange system upon successful validation. The architecture will be similar to Figure 21-6 with some improvements, such as the OMS can be owned by the broker application instead of relying on third-party vendors. We already recommended including a separate deployment per stock exchange for the systems with behavior specific to each stock exchange. An additional component from Figure 21-6 will be an offline data orchestrator to work asynchronously for updates received from the stock exchange system at the end of the day for the trades executed.

市价订单执行系统中的请求流与市场数据投递系统中的流向相反。请求从用户开始，带着执行一笔订单的意图。股票经纪系统验证该执行请求，并在验证成功后把请求转发给股票交易所系统。架构将类似于图 21-6，但有一些改进，例如 OMS 可以由经纪应用自有，而不是依赖第三方供应商。对于行为因股票交易所而异的系统，我们已经建议为每个股票交易所单独部署。相比图 21-6，额外的一个组件将是离线数据编排器，异步处理当天结束时从股票交易所系统收到的、关于已执行交易的更新。

The stock exchange is not guaranteed to send the response of order execution against the same request, so we should think about introducing a queue before the OMS. The broker application, upon receiving the request, runs the set of rules to identify if the order can be executed and publishes the request to the OMS queue. The OMS polls the messages from the queue and forwards to the stock exchange system for actual order matching. The Day N architecture is shown in Figure 21-8.

股票交易所不保证针对同一个请求回送订单执行的响应，因此我们应当考虑在 OMS 之前引入一个队列。经纪应用收到请求后，运行那一组规则以判断该订单是否可以执行，并把请求发布到 OMS 队列。OMS 从队列中轮询消息，转发给股票交易所系统进行实际订单撮合。Day N 架构如图 21-8 所示。

Page 586

We discussed improving execution latency in “Scaling to Millions and Beyond” on page 559; system resiliency is another important consideration for overall success.

我们在第 559 页“扩展到百万级及以上”中讨论了改善执行延迟；系统弹性是整体成功的另一个重要考虑。

System resilience

The system should be able to operate even in the case of hardware failures and recover without any downtimes. The general recommendation to improve resiliency of applications is to deploy in multiple AZs and regions. Most AWS-managed services take care of this by default; for example, Amazon Aurora persists two copies of each write operation in three AZs.

即使在硬件故障的情况下，系统也应当能够运行，并在没有任何停机的情况下恢复。提高应用弹性的一般建议是跨多个 AZ 和区域部署。大多数 AWS 托管服务默认就处理了这一点；例如，Amazon Aurora 把每次写操作的两份副本持久化到三个 AZ。

We generally deploy the infrastructure across the AZs of an AWS region, and it by default takes care of issues like AZ downtimes (which rarely happen). With respect to stockbroker applications, we discussed using on-premises data centers or AWS local zones for infrastructure hosting, which brings the maintenance overhead onto our plate.

我们通常把基础设施跨 AWS 区域的多个 AZ 部署，它默认就处理了 AZ 停机之类的问题（这种情况很少发生）。对于股票经纪应用，我们讨论过使用本地数据中心或 AWS Local Zone 来托管基础设施，这把维护开销带到了我们自己身上。

Page 587

Follow these recommendations to improve system resiliency:

遵循以下建议来提高系统弹性：

  • To avoid issues in a server rack, keep a duplicate server rack with the same set of services so that the system can default to another server rack in case of failures.
    为避免单个服务器机架出问题，保留一个带有相同服务集的备用服务器机架，以便在发生故障时系统可以默认切换到另一个服务器机架。
  • If the entire data center goes down, the system should be able to operate from a different data center. The other data center can again be on-premises or systems deployed in one of the AZs of an AWS region. With the assumption that these scenarios rarely happen, our recommendation is to host the same set of services in the AWS region, and traffic can be served from there for any issues. The important thing to consider here is active database replication to refer to the current state of ongoing orders and continue the operations from other data centers.
    如果整个数据中心宕机，系统应当能够从另一个数据中心运行。另一个数据中心同样可以是本地的，或者部署在 AWS 区域某个 AZ 中的系统。在这些场景很少发生的假设下，我们建议在 AWS 区域托管相同的服务集，出现任何问题时可以从那里服务流量。这里要考虑的重要一点是活动数据库复制，以便参考正在进行订单的当前状态，并从其他数据中心继续操作。
  • Figure 21-8 shows one OMS per stock exchange. There is a further possibility of sharding the workload, removing the single point of failure. Each sharded OMS has independent connectivity with the stock exchange network, increasing the overall availability of the system.
    图 21-8 中每个股票交易所一个 OMS。还有进一步把工作负载分片的可能，以消除单点故障。每个分片后的 OMS 与股票交易网络都有独立连接，从而提高系统整体可用性。

Conclusion

Choosing infrastructure and technology is equally as important as writing software; a perfectly written software application can perform badly if inappropriate technology for deployment is selected. The focus of Part III has been on identifying the requirements and the business use case to finalize a solution.

选择基础设施和技术与编写软件同等重要；如果为部署选择了不合适的技术，一个写得完美的软件应用也可能表现糟糕。第三部分的重点一直是识别需求和业务用例，以最终确定一个方案。

We gathered multiple suggestions and optimizations that we can do at the software and infrastructure levels for improving the execution latency of systems. There are very few ultra-low-latency business use cases, and they require specific solutions. We recommend having maximum control of the software and hardware for these use cases. Every decision with software and hardware configurations becomes important with ultra-low-latency systems, so we don’t recommend fully managed services for these use cases. The reason is simple: the fully managed services are designed for all general-purpose use cases, but you have very specific requirements. The fully managed service might be bundled with 10 features, but you just need one with full control.

我们收集了多项可以在软件和基础设施层面做的建议和优化，以改善系统的执行延迟。超低延迟的业务用例非常少，它们需要特定的方案。我们建议对这些用例的软件和硬件拥有最大程度的控制。对于超低延迟系统，软件和硬件配置上的每个决策都变得重要，因此我们不建议这些用例使用全托管服务。原因很简单：全托管服务是为所有通用用例设计的，而你有非常特定的需求。全托管服务可能捆绑了 10 个功能，但你只需要一个能完全掌控的。

Let’s look at an example of self-hosting versus using cloud-managed services and compare it to cooking your own food versus hiring a cook (or ordering online, eating out, etc.) for preparing meals. Cooking food (or self-hosting software) gives you full control to the lowest of the configurations. If you hire a cook, you can buy groceries or spices, but you can’t control the cooking speed, chopping style, quantity of spices—and the list goes on. This is the same with managed services: you may be able to specify RAM size and number of vCPUs (or any other configuration depending on

让我们看一个自建 vs. 使用云托管服务的例子，把它比作自己做饭 vs. 雇一个厨师（或在线点餐、外出就餐等）来准备饭菜。做饭（或自建软件）让你对最底层的配置拥有完全控制。如果你雇一个厨师，你可以买菜或调料，但你无法控制做饭速度、切菜方式、调料用量——诸如此类。托管服务也是一样：你或许可以指定 RAM 大小和 vCPU 数量（或任何其他取决于

Page 588

the service), but you don’t have the control to tune the software at the OS or hardware level.

该服务的其他任何配置），但你无法在操作系统或硬件层面调优软件。

I (Mandeep) cook my own food. I like the process, and it doesn’t take much time because I have gained expertise over time. People are really surprised when they learn that I cook my own meals, and I get a lot of questions about time management. This is also an issue with self-hosting—you might get worried about engineering-bandwidth requirements for managing the systems, the learning curve, how to handle system downtimes, and so on, but these are not issues most of the time. The theme of this entire book is making sure you evaluate your business use cases before making a decision. If you’re able to justify the decision of using managed services, then go ahead with it. For example, I cook food almost every day but take a break from cooking and save some time for other interests by ordering biryani from Zomato (an online food-ordering platform in India similar to DoorDash in the US) every Sunday afternoon.

我（Mandeep）自己做饭。我喜欢这个过程，而且并不花很多时间，因为我随着时间积累了经验。当人们知道我自己做饭时真的很惊讶，我也收到很多关于时间管理的问题。自建也有同样的问题——你可能会担心管理系统所需的工程带宽、学习曲线、如何处理系统停机等等，但大多数时候这些都不是问题。本书的主题是：在做决策之前，务必评估你的业务用例。如果你能证明使用托管服务的决策是合理的，那就放手去用。例如，我几乎每天都自己做饭，但每周日下午会休息一下、从 Zomato（印度的在线点餐平台，类似于美国的 DoorDash）点一份 biryani，为其他兴趣省点时间。

It’s not possible to cover each and every aspect of AWS systems within the scope of this book. Think about what we’ve talked about throughout the book and applying what you’ve learned to the systems that you’re designing or that you aspire to design. We hope this book has helped enhance your understanding of system design in the AWS cloud and wish you the very best for your future system-design decisions.

在本书范围内，不可能涵盖 AWS 系统的每一个方面。想一想我们在全书讨论过的内容，并把你学到的东西应用到你正在设计或渴望设计的系统中。我们希望本书帮助加深了你对 AWS 云上系统设计的理解，并祝你未来的系统设计决策一切顺利。
